requirements.requirement: Provide a logical volume mounted at /srv/data on node1.
requirements.summary: Direct observations show /dev/vg_data/lv_data mounted at /srv/data as XFS, both before growth and after reboot.

requirements.requirement: Grow the logical volume to at least 2 GB while it remains mounted and its contents remain intact.
requirements.summary: The LV was directly observed growing online from 1024 MiB to 2304 MiB. The mount ID remained 407 throughout, the filesystem expanded to 2.2G, and the proof-file SHA-256 remained unchanged.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct before-and-after evidence. The independent restart protocol is also complete: node1 had a healthy pre-restart state, an acknowledged restart, a changed boot ID, and recovered LV, mount, data, SSH, and service health. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the restart.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Installing LVM, creating the file-backed PV/VG/LV, formatting and mounting it, creating test content, performing the online extension, and configuring persistent activation all directly supported the requested outcome or its verification. The reboot mutation was required by the provider-wide restart protocol. Failed post-reboot polling commands show connection interruption but no unrelated state change. Final observations show no failed services, package-manager inconsistency, unexpected listening sockets, or abandoned temporary files.
